target_only_tests.why: None. Every collected test in this file is a translation of a source case.

approved_non_running.reason: The source's `entry` fixture calls `pytest.skip(reason)` when `registry.PROVIDERS[id].unavailable()` is not None -- one skip per case, at RUN time, so pytest still COLLECTS a node id for it. Ported the same way `substitution-scenarios.test.ts` is: each of the six `[S2]` cases is registered with its own literal `skipIf(S2_UNAVAILABLE !== null, ...)(...)` call rather than a shared, entry-parameterised wrapper, so the exact collected title is present verbatim in this file's source text for `scripts/parity-check.mjs`'s own `declaresTitle` sweep (needed on a host without `claude` on PATH, where `vitest list` omits the case entirely and the check falls back to reading the source). Six calls, one per `[S2]` case in this file, matching `substitution-scenarios.test.ts`'s own six.

entries.reason: Same assertions -- zero failures, exit code 0, nothing skipped -- over `support/run.ts`'s RunResult rather than pytest's own outcome dict.
